<!doctype html>
<html lang="ro">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0f3b78">
<title>Padel Training Designer V48</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#eef4f8;--panel:#fff;--line:#d7e2ea;--ink:#17324a;--muted:#5f7b90;--blue:#0f5ea7;--navy:#102f63;--yellow:#ffd45d}
*{box-sizing:border-box} body{margin:0;font-family:Inter,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f7fbff,#eaf2f8);color:var(--ink);-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.page{max-width:1680px;margin:auto;padding:12px}.top{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:10px 14px;box-shadow:0 10px 24px #1232 0;margin-bottom:10px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-width:0}.brand img{width:132px;height:66px;object-fit:contain}.brand h1{font-size:22px;margin:0;color:var(--navy)}.brand p{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin:4px 0 0}
.meta{display:flex;gap:7px}.meta input,input[type=text],input[type=file],textarea{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;background:#fff;padding:9px;font:inherit}.meta input{width:175px}
.workspace{display:grid;grid-template-columns:310px minmax(0,1fr);gap:10px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:10px;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(15,38,58,.09)}
.dock{background:#f8fbfd;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:9px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;position:sticky;top:8px;max-height:96vh;overflow:auto}
.group{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:8px}.group h3{margin:0 0 7px;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;color:#4d6980}
.palette{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px}.tool{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border:1px solid #dce6ee;border-radius:11px;padding:5px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;min-width:0;user-select:none;touch-action:manipulation}
.tool img{width:48px;height:54px;object-fit:contain;pointer-events:none}.tool span{font-size:9px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.05}.tool.active{outline:3px solid #81b8e5;background:#edf7ff}
.row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px}.fields{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}.fields label{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#527089}
button{border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 10px;background:#e8f0f7;color:#17324a;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1765ad,#102f63);color:#fff}.danger{background:#ffe8e8;color:#a12626}.activeBtn{outline:3px solid #9ac6e8;background:#edf7ff}
.status{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);padding:6px 2px}
.boardcol{min-width:0}.board{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:7px;background:#fff;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}.boardtitle{font-size:11px;font-weight:900;color:#45657f;margin:2px 2px 6px}
#stage{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;min-height:820px;border-radius:13px;overflow:hidden;background:#eef4f8;touch-action:pan-x pan-y}
#court{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:1}#items{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2}#draw{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;touch-action:none}
#stage.arrow #draw,#stage.pencil #draw{pointer-events:auto}#stage.arrow,#stage.pencil{touch-action:none}#stage.arrow #items,#stage.pencil #items{pointer-events:none}
.item{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transform-origin:center;touch-action:none;user-select:none;cursor:grab}.item img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;pointer-events:none}.item.selected{outline:2px dashed var(--yellow);border-radius:9px}.badge{position:absolute;right:-5px;bottom:-4px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--ink);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:900}
.handle{display:none}.selected>.handle{display:block;position:absolute;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--ink);z-index:5}.resize{right:-9px;bottom:-9px}.rotate{left:50%;top:-28px;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.textItem{padding:5px 8px;background:#fffffff2;border:1px solid #3554;border-radius:9px;color:var(--ink);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-align:center;min-width:85px;min-height:28px}
.notes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:8px}.card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:8px;background:#fff}.card label{display:block;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:4px}.card textarea{width:100%;min-height:68px;resize:vertical}
@media(max-width:1050px){.workspace{grid-template-columns:270px 1fr}#stage{min-height:650px}.notes{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:700px){
.page{padding:4px}.top{border-radius:13px;padding:7px;display:block}.brand img{width:86px;height:48px}.brand h1{font-size:16px}.brand p{font-size:9px}.meta{margin-top:6px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.meta input{width:100%;font-size:11px;padding:7px}
.workspace{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:5px;border-radius:13px}.dock{position:relative;top:auto;max-height:none;overflow:visible;width:100%;padding:5px;gap:6px;order:1}.boardcol{order:2}
.group{width:100%;padding:6px}.palette{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px}.tool{flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:4px 2px;min-height:78px}.tool img{width:42px;height:45px}.tool span{font-size:7.5px}
button{min-height:40px;padding:7px 8px;font-size:10px}.fields input{min-height:38px;font-size:11px}.board{padding:4px}.boardtitle{font-size:9px}
#stage{width:680px;min-height:540px;aspect-ratio:4/3}.notes{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:5px}.selected>.handle{width:24px;height:24px}.resize{right:-12px;bottom:-12px}.rotate{top:-36px}
}
@media(max-width:390px){.palette{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="page">
  <header class="top">
    <div class="brand"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="logo"><div><h1>Padel Training Designer</h1><p>CEAUȘ VITALIE · PADEL COACH — proiectare exerciții și pregătire funcțională</p></div></div>
    <div class="meta"><input id="session" type="text" placeholder="Denumirea sesiunii"><input id="duration" type="text" placeholder="Durată, ex. 60 min"></div>
  </header>
  <main class="workspace">
    <aside class="dock">
      <section class="group"><h3>Jucători și mingi</h3><div class="palette" id="players"></div></section>
      <section class="group"><h3>Echipament sportiv</h3><div class="palette" id="equipment"></div></section>
      <section class="group"><h3>Text și desen</h3>
        <div class="row"><button id="moveBtn" class="activeBtn">Mutare</button><button id="pencilBtn">✎ Creion</button><button id="arrowBtn">➜ Săgeată</button><button id="undoBtn">Undo</button><button id="clearBtn" class="danger">Șterge tot</button></div>
        <div class="fields" style="margin-top:7px"><input id="textInput" type="text" placeholder="Scrie textul..."><button id="textBtn" class="primary">T Adaugă text</button><label>Grosime creion / săgeată</label><input id="stroke" type="range" min="1" max="8" value="3"><button id="eraseDraw">Șterge desenele</button></div>
      </section>
      <section class="group"><h3>Obiect selectat</h3><div class="fields"><label>Dimensiune</label><input id="size" type="range" min="20" max="200" value="70"><label>Rotire</label><input id="rotation" type="range" min="0" max="359" value="0"><div class="row"><button id="left">↺ -15°</button><button id="right">↻ +15°</button><button id="deleteBtn" class="danger">Șterge obiect</button></div></div></section>
      <section class="group"><h3>Imagine proprie</h3><div class="fields"><input id="upload" type="file" accept="image/*"><button id="addUpload">Adaugă imaginea</button></div></section>
      <section class="group"><h3>Export</h3><div class="row"><button id="png" class="primary">Export PNG</button><button id="pngPrint">PNG tipar</button><button id="print">Tipărește</button></div></section>
      <div class="status" id="status">Selectează un obiect, apoi atinge terenul.</div>
    </aside>
    <div class="boardcol">
      <section class="board">
        <div class="boardtitle">TEREN DE PADEL · PROIECTARE EXERCIȚII</div>
        <div id="stage">
          <svg id="court" viewBox="0 0 1200 720" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
            <defs>
              <linearGradient id="courtFill" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#5fa6d8"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#4a96cc"/></linearGradient>
              <pattern id="netPattern" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="10" height="10"><rect width="10" height="10" fill="#e8f2fa"/><path d="M0 0H10M0 5H10M0 10H10M0 0V10M5 0V10M10 0V10" stroke="#7d95a7" stroke-width="1"/></pattern>
            </defs>
            <rect width="1200" height="720" fill="#f6fafc"/>
            <polygon points="250,45 950,45 1135,675 65,675" fill="#555b61"/>
            <polygon points="270,65 930,65 1105,655 95,655"
